title: Hansel and Gretel: The House of Bread
galleryTitle: Hansel and Gretel: The House of Bread
author: Brothers Grimm
descriptionEn: A rich, beginner-friendly English retelling of the Brothers Grimm tale Hansel and Gretel. Seven chapters with full scenes and dialogue: the white pebbles, the lost bread crumbs, the house of bread and the clever little sister, with a vocabulary guide.
descriptionPt: Um reconto rico e acessível, em inglês simples, de João e Maria dos Irmãos Grimm. Sete capítulos: as pedrinhas brancas, as migalhas perdidas, a casa de pão e a irmã esperta, com guia de vocabulário.
adaptationCredit: Adapted for beginner learners (A1) for Bookmoo. New text written from the structure of the Grimm tale; not a copy of any published translation.
sources: Brothers Grimm, Kinder- und Haus-Märchen, KHM 15 'Hänsel und Gretel' (1st ed. 1812; final text 1857, with a stepmother). Read in the historical English translation in Project Gutenberg #2591 (Edgar Taylor / Marian Edwardes) to confirm events and order.
rights: Original tale: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm died in 1863 and 1859, so the work is in the public domain worldwide. The adaptation is new original text written for Bookmoo and copies no translation. It uses no names, songs, designs or characters from film, stage or opera versions. Cover: original artwork made for Bookmoo.
